finalText:
Redis died at 02:14:07 and never came back.

```
02:14:07 ERROR [api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
02:31:26 ERROR [api] redis reconnect attempt 12 failed: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
02:31:44 ERROR [worker-2] JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)
02:31:52 FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down
```

Cache fell back to direct store reads. Then 173 store timeouts at 5000ms. Queue depth climbed 52 to 568, past the 500 cap. Nothing shed load. Death took 17 minutes.

Next: fix Redis at 10.0.0.12, then add a circuit breaker and real load shedding.
